payload.description: Boon passive, not a rotation. Zeus Lightning Strike boon: every attack hit emits chain-lightning that bounces to nearby enemies, dealing Lightning Damage. Thunder Flourish applies similar chain-lightning on Special hits. Jolted status (from Static Discharge upgrade) causes enemies to damage themselves when they attack, consuming the status. Loop: hit frequently → chain-hop lightning procs per hit → pack damage. Economy: pure proc on hit, no extra resource.
